answer: Sybil resistance arises when each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and its signing key is sealed to that enclave. Remote verifiers accept only valid hardware-backed quotes, so duplicating an identity in virtual machines cannot reproduce the attested measurement or key. Creating another identity therefore requires purchasing physical silicon and provisioning a distinct enclave, while trellis, relic, and vault are merely protocol labels.
